displayName: SailPoint ISC — Failed authentication or action burst
description: Detects five or more failed SailPoint authentication events for the same actor, target, or account in one hour and includes the authentication source, target account, host IP, and Entra UPN.
query:
let FailureThreshold = 5;
SailPointISC_Events
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where IsAuth and IsFailure
| extend SubjectName = coalesce(UserId, TargetIdentity, Actor, "unknown")
| extend ActorKey = tolower(Actor), TargetKey = tolower(coalesce(TargetIdentity, Target)), UserKey = tolower(UserId)
| summarize
    FailureCount = count(),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
    EventNames = strcat_array(make_set(EventName, 5), ", "),
    Actions = strcat_array(make_set(ActionName, 10), ", "),
    AccountSources = strcat_array(make_set(SourceName, 5), ", "),
    TargetAccounts = strcat_array(make_set_if(TargetAccount, isnotempty(TargetAccount) and TargetAccount != "unknown", 5), ", "),
    Hosts = strcat_array(make_set_if(HostName, isnotempty(HostName), 5), ", "),
    EventDetails = substring(strcat_array(make_set(EventSummary, 5), " | "), 0, 900),
    TargetBracketSource = any(TargetBracketSource)
    by Actor, Target, SubjectName, ActorKey, TargetKey, UserKey
| where FailureCount >= FailureThreshold
| join kind=leftouter (SailPointISC_IdentityKeys | project TargetKey = JoinKey, TargetUpn = UserPrincipalName, TargetDisplay = DisplayName, TargetIdSource = IdentitySource) on TargetKey
| join kind=leftouter (SailPointISC_IdentityKeys | project UserKey = JoinKey, UserUpn = UserPrincipalName, UserDisplay = DisplayName, UserIdSource = IdentitySource) on UserKey
| join kind=leftouter (SailPointISC_IdentityKeys | project ActorKey = JoinKey, ActorUpn = UserPrincipalName, ActorDisplay = DisplayName, ActorIdSource = IdentitySource) on ActorKey
| extend
    UserPrincipalName = coalesce(TargetUpn, UserUpn, ActorUpn),
    DisplayName = coalesce(TargetDisplay, UserDisplay, ActorDisplay, SubjectName),
    IdentityAuthoritativeSource = coalesce(TargetBracketSource, TargetIdSource, UserIdSource, ActorIdSource, "SailPoint ISC"),
    ResponseSubject = iff(isnotempty(TargetUpn) or isnotempty(UserUpn), "Target", "Actor")
| extend
    ResponseAction = "Open this UPN in Assets > Identities. Reset the password, then revoke sessions.",
    UpnSuffix = tostring(split(UserPrincipalName, "@")[1]),
    AccountCustomEntity = iff(isnotempty(UserPrincipalName), UserPrincipalName, SubjectName),
    Hosts = coalesce(Hosts, "unknown"),
    AlertTarget = strcat(DisplayName, iff(isnotempty(TargetAccounts) and tolower(TargetAccounts) != tolower(DisplayName), strcat(" [acct: ", TargetAccounts, "]"), ""), iff(isnotempty(IdentityAuthoritativeSource) and IdentityAuthoritativeSource != "SailPoint ISC", strcat(" (HR: ", IdentityAuthoritativeSource, ")"), ""))
